verdict.rationale: Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at /docs/openapi.json, covering 84 paths, and embeds per-operation OpenAPI in every endpoint page's markdown mirror. The probe 404s were on different root-level paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.), so they do not contradict the /docs/openapi.json location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the /docs/openapi.json path resolves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (84 paths, server https://cloud.activepieces.com/api) backing its Mintlify API reference, with per-operation OpenAPI embedded in every endpoint page's markdown mirror.
